messages.subject: Differential methylation between genic features only
parts:
Hello, 

I was able to successfully overlap my differentially methylated regions with genic features using Methylkit. I was wondering if there was a method to call differential methylation only between genic features ? 

Thank you

Aditi

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Differential methylation between genic features onl
parts:
Thanks ! yes using it exactly like that :

feature_gr_2kb <- promoters(feature_gr, upstream=2000, downstream=0)

feature_gr_window <- slidingWindows(feature_gr_2kb,200,step=200)

miRegions <-regionCounts(myobj, feature_gr_window)

Aditi
